approval_contract.approval_reference: The approved payload is a separately reviewed immutable receipt; approval_receipt.path and sha256 bind its exact bytes.
approval_contract.approved_plan_core_sha256_required: SHA256 of canonical JSON for every plan field except approval_receipt; use reference_launch_controller.plan_core_sha on the final executable plan.
approval_contract.descriptor_binding: Every allowed task requires descriptor case_id equal to selected case and size standard, checked before and after the child.
approval_contract.refresh_rule: Any change to executable task, source, descriptor, environment, limits, output path, current cost snapshot, status or launch flag requires a newly reviewed approval receipt.
approval_contract.sparse_support_binding: Case8 and case20 load the sparse support unconditionally; exact actual sibling path and SHA are required and checked before and after the child.

cost_ledger_note: Refresh and hash current canonical COST_EVENTS chain plus all native/controller costs after source freeze. No historical cost reset; fixed cap172800s and absolute deadline.

prior_reference_context.case20: No case20 reference solve is authorized by this nonlaunchable template. Freeze a clean reviewed source commit, refresh cumulative costs and obtain a new exact plan approval before one bounded attempt.
prior_reference_context.case8_attempt: ATTEMPT_001 under references/case08 is preserved failed/partial context; do not overwrite or reuse as a successful reference. New run gets fresh output directory.
prior_reference_context.cases9_11: Independent cases: a failed case8 does not block a separately predeclared and reviewed case9 or case11 plan. Each invocation refreshes the same cumulative cost snapshot, uses a fresh exclusive output and obtains separate approval; never substitutes a task in an already approved plan.

template_note: NONLAUNCHABLE. Exactly one predeclared case8 OR case9 OR case11 per invocation, each with a900s whole-controller reservation/cap including preflight and final receipts. Use the separate case templates before review. Requires frozen source, case-specific script/descriptor hashes, versioned Julia binary/environment, current global cost snapshot and hash-bound independent single-task plan approval. Never resets global task/cost root, cap or absolute deadline. Shared mutex participation remains HOLD until independent hash-bound review.
